title: FlowMetrics — Real-Time Analytics for Product Teams
subtitle: Ship faster with confidence. Know what users actually do.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.content: Product teams spend 40% of their time arguing about what to build next — because they don't have real usage data. Spreadsheets and gut feelings lead to shipping features nobody uses. Meanwhile, churn creeps up and nobody knows why until it's too late.

sections.title: How FlowMetrics Works
sections.content: One SDK. Five minutes to integrate. FlowMetrics captures every user interaction — clicks, scrolls, rage clicks, feature usage, session recordings — and turns it into actionable dashboards your whole team can understand. No SQL required. Auto-generated insights surface what's working and what's not before you have to ask.

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content: Real-time event streaming with sub-second latency. Cohort analysis and user segmentation. Funnel visualization with drop-off detection. Feature adoption tracking. Session replay with privacy masking. AI-powered anomaly detection alerts. Custom dashboards with drag-and-drop builder. SOC 2 Type II certified.

sections.title: Customer Results
sections.content: Notion reduced feature development cycles by 30% using FlowMetrics adoption data. Canva identified and fixed a checkout flow issue that was costing $2.1M/year in abandoned upgrades. Linear credits FlowMetrics with helping them achieve 95% feature adoption rates across their user base.

sections.title: Pricing
sections.content: Starter: Free up to 10K events/month. Growth: $299/month for up to 10M events. Scale: $899/month for up to 100M events. Enterprise: Custom pricing with dedicated support, SLA, and on-premise option.
